posts.post_subject: Let me try this a different way
posts.content_md: It’s hard to say. I understand little of photography, but realize it is important to holography so I try when possible to apply it as I learn. Art is present because I just like things to look nice and be expressive and photography principles lend towards artistic solutions, even if I am bad at it. Science is present out of curiosity and holography is a horribly nice tool for exploration. It just turns out that I like to have my cake and eat it too, so why not appeal to all three at once?
